title: Test Databricks guardrails across both tracking URI forms and assert no client init
answers: how to test databricks tracking uri guardrail
test that fluent API rejects databricks uri without calling client
body:
Convention: Guardrail tests for mlflow.genai fluent functions are parametrized over the function (with its args and kwargs) and over tracking URIs "databricks" and "databricks://profile".
Each case patches mlflow.tracking.get_tracking_uri to return the Databricks URI and patches the client class __init__ (e.g. f"{_BASE}.__init__").
Assertions: pytest.raises(MlflowException, match=f"{fn.__name__} is not supported in Databricks environments"), error_code == "INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE", the alternative text appears in str(exc), and the patched client __init__ is not called.
Place these in tests/genai/review_queues/test_review_queues_sdk.py alongside the existing SDK tests.
applies: Tests for any function decorated with databricks_api_disabled in mlflow/genai; not for tests of the non-Databricks path.
says: Review queue operations should immediately reject Databricks tracking connections before initializing any client.
Review queue commands fail to block Databricks tracking profiles with proper unsupported environment messages.
Ensure generative AI review queues reject both default and profiled Databricks tracking servers.
Review queue actions should display clear alternative guidance when run against Databricks environments.
search: Guardrail tests for mlflow.genai functions decorated with databricks_api_disabled must test both databricks and databricks://profile tracking URI formats. In tests/genai/review_queues/test_review_queues_sdk.py, patch mlflow.tracking.get_tracking_uri and client initialization, asserting that the client is never initialized. Tests assert an INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE MlflowException stating the function is not supported in Databricks environments alongside helpful alternative guidance text.
